finding: State-resampling ranges were discussed using significance language.
correction: Relabeled as geographic diagnostics, not CPS survey-design confidence intervals or national significance.
remaining_requirement: Full design and common occupation-shock uncertainty remain unestimated.

finding: Only the proportional co-primary entry test appeared in the principal table.
correction: Added additive +0.962 pp, its working interval, raw and two-test Holm p-values, and trend/recovery sensitivity.
remaining_requirement: Positive paired-outcome contrast is not an increase in Q5 employment or protection by AI.

finding: Destination-industry effects change the entry estimand.
correction: Explained within-industry allocation and potential absorption of sector reallocation; reported no-industry sensitivity.
remaining_requirement: Neither specification identifies a total causal hiring effect.

finding: FT-stock-normalized flow intensities could be read as transition probabilities or mechanism tests.
correction: Clarified stock normalization, changing denominators and distinction from controlled risk-set DID.
remaining_requirement: Missing mechanisms cannot be ruled out by ranges spanning zero.

finding: Near-zero dual-calibration residual could imply robustness to unknown missing transitions.
correction: Identified one margin-consistent weighting convention; clarified tautology and fixed-weight bootstrap constraints.
remaining_requirement: Alternative allocations of missing transitions remain unidentified.

finding: Released CPS age was described as exact, and age-bin movement as aging.
correction: Changed CPS age language to recorded age; documented age perturbation, 4,780 strict-rule rejections and unverified birthdays.
remaining_requirement: Not all rejected ages are attributed to perturbation; selection impact has not been quantified.

finding: The January 2020 code term could be mistaken for all effects of recoding.
correction: Qualified +0.840 log points as continuing-FT/target-age bookkeeping; documented age-first and schedule-first allocation.
remaining_requirement: Interaction allocation is order-dependent; schedule-first versus occupation-first sensitivity not estimated.

finding: ACS stock validation could be read as validating a November 2022 break.
evidence: ACS pooled estimates and hours definitions
correction: Added immediate result-level timing, measure and causal limitations.
remaining_requirement: Annual pooled comparison does not locate the break or prove parallel trends.

finding: Canaries row omitted its payroll hiring/separation analysis and its actual exposure contrast.
evidence: Canaries August 2026 primary PDF, physical pages 1 and 3
correction: Acknowledged hiring-flow result and two-highest versus three-lowest quintile contrast; retained descriptive caveat.
remaining_requirement: Not a direct replication of our Q5/Q1–Q4 survey estimand.

finding: Our result was described as not reproducing Atkinson–Yamco despite different estimands.
correction: Identified age, tertile and entrant-risk-set differences; removed replication/refutation wording.
remaining_requirement: Different risk sets cannot be used to claim contradiction.

finding: The offered-quality research question exceeded primary evidence on stocks and realized transitions.
evidence: 190 scored historical quality observations; missing denominators
correction: Added answerability boundary in Introduction and top conclusion.
remaining_requirement: Comparable pay, benefits, training and contract-duration offers remain exploratory.

finding: Unresolved attribution risked being presented as a new general methodological discovery.
evidence: Prior Canaries, Dallas Fed, Tucker and Frazis studies
correction: Reframed contribution as incremental alternate-exposure public-data triangulation and sensitivity audit.
remaining_requirement: No new causal mechanism or superior THAIE validity is established.

finding: The CPS relative ratio lacked its own-group point changes near the headline.
correction: Added Q5 −0.97% and Q1–Q4 +9.20% alongside the −9.31% relative ratio.
remaining_requirement: The ratio diagnostic range is not an interval for either own-group change.

finding: Raw stock versus adjusted model comparison could attribute all differences to controls.
correction: Explained broader raw-stock universe versus common-supported FT/PT occupation–industry model rows.
remaining_requirement: Support and specification differ; no unique decomposition of the estimate difference is claimed.
